name: Return to Thunder Bluff
label: Quest
description: This quest charges an operative with carrying a potent chemical agent brewed by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill back across the sea to Thunder Bluff.…
intro: This quest charges an operative with carrying a potent chemical agent brewed by Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill back across the sea to Thunder Bluff. There, Apothecary Zamah awaits the compound so she can engineer a dispersal apparatus against the Venture Company. It marks a crucial step in the Royal Apothecary Society's clandestine research under the very roofs of their Tauren hosts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here is the toxin. If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field!
But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have returned, friend. Do you bring aid from Apothecary Lydon?

clips.title: Completion
paras: A toxin from Apothecary Lydon? Very good. If I know Lydon, then this toxin will be quite effective against the Venture Company...
